title: The intake hook re-files a draft that land set aside in a linked worktree outside .claude/worktrees/, since land writes under its own root and the hook reads only the main worktree's set-aside directory
goal: Found in the SP-lyfnpu37 review (bl_land.py:765 and :1395, bl_intake.py:361): land moves its own checkout's drafts to _cache/intake-drafts/ under the root it runs in, while set_aside_fingerprints reads only the clone's main worktree's _cache/intake-drafts/, so in a linked worktree outside .claude/worktrees/ the next SessionStart files the same finding again (ST-gdcn5467's clause 'files once'). A draft land sets aside in any checkout of the clone is one the hook skips.
repro_reason: found by reading; the case needs a linked worktree outside .claude/worktrees/ and a second SessionStart
